_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-07 14:15:50Z)**_

Here is the full list, worked out against the content you actually have: 5 projects, 1 job, 4 education entries, 10 tech skills, 5 capabilities, contact details, résumé, socials and the YouTube demo. No code yet.

# Rules for every object

1. **Click opens, drag moves.** If the pointer moves less than 5px and is released within 250ms, it counts as a click and opens the section. Anything longer is a drag, as it works now. Hovering shows a small label like "Projects ↗" so people find the entry points.
2. **Same open/close pattern for every section:**
   1. The object lifts and flies toward the camera, or the camera moves in to it.
   2. The rest of the desk goes out of focus and darkens.
   3. The content appears on the object itself (paper, screen, page) or as a panel lined up with it.
   4. Esc, a click on the empty desk, or the browser back button reverses the animation, and the object lands exactly where it was.
3. **Each opened section gets its own URL**, like `/projects/abc-cars` or `/about`, so links can be shared and the back button works.
4. **The hand only appears in three moments: projects, contact and résumé.** Used everywhere it gets slow and stops being special. The other sections use the object's own movement: flip, open on a hinge, stamp, spill.
5. **Accessibility and search:**
   - An "Index" list (keyboard shortcut `I`) offers every section as a normal link.
   - Every section's text also exists as real page text, so search engines and screen readers can read it.
   - Reduced-motion users get a fade instead of the animation.
   - A click during an animation skips to its end.

# Section, object and transition

| Section | Object | Trigger and transition |
|---|---|---|
| Projects | Desk drawer, then a manila folder, then project documents | The hand opens the drawer and brings out the folder |
| About | Your portrait polaroid | Lifts and flips to a handwritten back |
| Experience + Education | Notebook with an elastic band | The band snaps off, the cover opens, pages turn per year |
| Tech stack | Tray of keyboard keycaps | Tips over; keycaps spill and bounce into a grid |
| What I do | 5 rubber stamps | Each stamp presses a word onto paper |
| Contact | Nothing Phone, face down | Flips over, glyph lights pulse, screen shows your contact card |
| Quick email | Business card | Click copies your email; the card tucks away |
| Résumé | Folded A4 sheet or clipboard | The hand slides it over and it unfolds |
| YouTube demo | Rangefinder camera | Viewfinder zoom, then a shutter-iris opening onto the video |
| Socials | Sticker sheet or enamel pins | Peel and lift |
| Light / dark mode | Desk lamp | Switch click, lighting changes to night |
| Easter egg | Cork coaster | A mug lands on it with steam |
| Help | Sticky note | Shows the controls |

# Details

## 1. Projects: drawer, folder, documents

- **Scenario A, your idea:**
  1. The camera pulls back and tilts from top-down to look at the front of the desk.
  2. A hand comes in from the bottom, pulls the drawer open, takes the "PROJECTS" folder and lifts it.
  3. The camera moves back to top-down and the hand drops the folder on the mat.
- **Scenario B, cheaper and still good:** an archive box on the corner of the desk. The hand lifts the lid and pulls the folder out. It needs no camera tilt and no modelling of the desk's front.
- **Folder opens** on its hinge. The 5 project documents fan out, each with a typed tab: ABC Cars, KYN, ABC Jobs, Jumpstart, Meals On Wheels.
- **A document** slides out and the camera moves in on it. Each one is a case file:
  - a paper-clipped printout of the screenshot,
  - the description in typewriter text,
  - the tech stack as a checklist,
  - a red "SHIPPED" stamp,
  - the GitHub link as a stamp-style button.
- **Moving between projects:** the page slides back into the folder and the next one comes out. Arrow keys work.
- **Extra:** for Jumpstart, which is a mobile app, a "view on device" button flips the phone up to show the mockup screens.

## 2. About: portrait polaroid

- The polaroid lifts, turns toward the camera and flips 180°.
- The back has your bio in handwriting-style italic, plus a date stamp.
- **Optional:** 2–3 more polaroids slide out from under it. Only worth it if you have real photos for them.

## 3. Experience + Education: notebook

- A notebook with an elastic band.
  1. The band snaps off.
  2. The cover opens on its hinge.
  3. Pages turn to each year: 2020 STEM, 2022 Google Cloud, 2023–24 Efunity, now Lithan / UC Banilad.
- **Alternative:** split it in two — a lanyard ID badge for Efunity (lift and spin) and a ring binder of certificates for education.

## 4. Tech stack: keycaps

- A small tray of keycaps, one per technology, using the icons you already have.
- Click: the tray tips over and the keycaps spill and bounce, then settle into a neat grid on the mat.
- Hovering a keycap shows its name. Pressing one makes it click down.
- Fits a developer, it's tactile, and it reuses the dragging and stacking already built.

## 5. What I do: 5 rubber stamps

- Visual, Design, Develop, Implement, Optimize.
- Clicking a stamp presses it onto a sheet of paper and leaves inked text with a short line underneath.
- **Alternative:** the utility knife cuts a paper strip and each word is revealed — plays on the cutting mat.

## 6. Contact: Nothing Phone

- The phone flips from face-down to face-up and the glyph lights pulse twice, like a call coming in.
- The screen shows your contact card: email, phone, socials. Tapping an entry opens it.
- Close: the phone flips back face-down.

## 7. Résumé

- The hand slides a folded A4 sheet into the centre.
- It unfolds in steps, like paper creases.
- A "Print / Download" button shows as a paper tab.

## 8. YouTube demo: camera

- The camera lifts toward the screen and a viewfinder frame takes over the view.
- A shutter-iris animation opens onto the embedded video.
- Close: the shutter closes and the camera goes back down.

## 9. Small extras

- **Lamp:** click toggles night mode — warm lamp pool of light, dark room, glyph lights glowing.
- **Coaster:** a mug drops on it and steam rises. Small reward for clicking around.
- **iPad:** swipe to unlock, and the home screen shows the 5 projects as app icons — a second way into projects for people who skip the drawer.

# Effort, cheapest first

1. Flips, lifting toward the camera, and cards: polaroid, phone, business card. Easy.
2. Hinged objects: folder, notebook, box lid. Medium; needs models with moving parts.
3. Keycap spill: medium; reuses the dragging and stacking already built.
4. Shutter iris and pen writing: medium; done on the page rather than in 3D.
5. **The hand: hard.** It needs a hand model — a ready-made free one or a stylised clay or wooden mannequin hand — plus scripted 2–3 second motion. I'd go with a matte clay mannequin hand: it fits the product-shot look and avoids looking creepy.
6. Camera tilting to the drawer: hard; the desk's front and drawer need modelling.

# Recommended order

1. Click-vs-drag detection, the shared open/close pattern, URLs, and the Index list.
2. Phone (Contact), polaroid (About), business card.
3. Folder and documents for Projects, using Scenario B (archive box) first.
4. Notebook (Experience + Education), keycaps (Tech stack).
5. Stamps, camera video, lamp.
6. The hand, then the drawer version of Projects.

# What I need from you

- **Hand style:** clay mannequin, realistic, or illustrated?
- **Projects:** box on the desk or drawer with the camera tilt? The box is faster to build.
- **Real photos for the About section**, if you want more than one polaroid.
- **Old sections:** should the Features / Product / Contact scroll sections below the desk go entirely, so the desk is the whole site?

import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
const [kind, id, res, outRoot] = process.argv.slice(2);
const j = await (await fetch(`https://api.polyhaven.com/files/${id}`)).json();
const save = async (url, rel) => {
  const p = join(outRoot, id, rel);
  mkdirSync(dirname(p), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(p, Buffer.from(await (await fetch(url)).arrayBuffer()));
};
if (kind === "model") {
  const g = j.gltf[res].gltf;
  await save(g.url, `${id}.gltf`);
  for (const [rel, v] of Object.entries(g.include ?? {})) await save(v.url, rel);
} else {
  for (const map of ["Diffuse", "Rough", "nor_gl"]) {
    const m = j[map]?.[res]?.jpg;
    if (m) await save(m.url, `${map.toLowerCase()}.jpg`);
  }
}
console.log("ok", id);
EOF

for (const id of process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const j = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`public/models/${id}/${id}.gltf`, "utf8"));
  const nodes = j.nodes.map((n) => [n.name, n.mesh, n.translation, n.rotation, n.scale, n.children]);
  let min = [1e9, 1e9, 1e9], max = [-1e9, -1e9, -1e9];
  for (const n of j.nodes) {
    if (n.mesh == null) continue;
    const t = n.translation ?? [0, 0, 0];
    for (const p of j.meshes[n.mesh].primitives) {
      const a = j.accessors[p.attributes.POSITION];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { min[i] = Math.min(min[i], a.min[i] + t[i]); max[i] = Math.max(max[i], a.max[i] + t[i]); }
    }
  }
  console.log(id, nodes.length, "min", min.map((v) => v.toFixed(3)), "max", max.map((v) => v.toFixed(3)), JSON.stringify(j.nodes.filter(n=>n.rotation||n.scale).map(n=>[n.name,n.rotation,n.scale])).slice(0,200));
}

"use client";

import { useGLTF } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

type Props = {
  url: string;
  /* longest horizontal side, in world units */
  size?: number;
  /* or: total height, in world units */
  height?: number;
  rotation?: [number, number, number];
};

/*
 * Loads a glTF, rescales it to a target size, and re-seats it so it rests on
 * y = 0 with its footprint centered on the origin — the same contract as the
 * procedural models.
 */
export function FitModel({ url, size, height, rotation = [0, 0, 0] }: Props) {
  const { scene } = useGLTF(url);

  const object = useMemo(() => {
    const root = scene.clone(true);
    root.rotation.set(...rotation);
    root.traverse((o) => {
      if ((o as THREE.Mesh).isMesh) {
        o.castShadow = true;
        o.receiveShadow = true;
      }
    });
    root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root);
    const dims = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
    const k = height ? height / dims.y : (size ?? 1) / Math.max(dims.x, dims.z);
    const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());

    const holder = new THREE.Group();
    root.position.set(-center.x, -box.min.y, -center.z);
    holder.add(root);
    holder.scale.setScalar(k);
    return holder;
  }, [scene, size, height, rotation]);

  return <primitive object={object} />;
}

export const MODEL_URLS = {
  camera: "/models/Camera_01/Camera_01.gltf",
  lamp: "/models/desk_lamp_arm_01/desk_lamp_arm_01.gltf",
  plant: "/models/potted_plant_02/potted_plant_02.gltf",
} as const;

/* ── Project books on the desk shelf ── */

export const BOOK_COLORS = ["#2f5a40", "#9c3d22", "#e7dcc6", "#1f2d44", "#b8862f"] as const;

function inkFor(bg: string) {
  return bg === "#e7dcc6" ? INK : "#f6ecdb";
}

function wrapLines(ctx: Ctx, text: string, maxWidth: number) {
  const words = text.split(/\s+/);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let line = "";
  for (const w of words) {
    const next = line ? `${line} ${w}` : w;
    if (ctx.measureText(next).width > maxWidth && line) {
      lines.push(line);
      line = w;
    } else line = next;
  }
  if (line) lines.push(line);
  return lines;
}

function clothTexture(ctx: Ctx, w: number, h: number, bg: string) {
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.07;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 3) ctx.fillRect(0, y, w, 1);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 4) ctx.fillRect(x, 0, 1, h);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  speckle(ctx, w, h, Math.round((w * h) / 400), ["rgba(0,0,0,0.5)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"], 0.8);
}

export type BookProject = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  tools: readonly string[];
  href: string;
  image: string;
};

export type BookTextures = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof buildBookTextures>>;

      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,100,70,${0.05 + Math.random() * 0.12})`;

  const books = projects.map((p, i) => {

    /* spine: title reads top-to-bottom */
    const spine = (() => {

      ctx.fillStyle = ink;

      ctx.translate(80, 60);

    const cover = (() => {

      wrapLines(ctx, p.title, 460).forEach((l, k) => ctx.fillText(l, 70, 380 + k * 82));

      ctx.fillText(`fig. ${num} — ${p.title}`, 80, 880);

    const right = (() => {

      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 70, 1200);

      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;

      let y = 200;
      for (const l of wrapLines(ctx, p.title, 620)) {
        ctx.fillText(l, 90, y);
        y += 78;
      }
      ctx.fillRect(90, y - 20, 620, 2);
      y += 50;
      ctx.font = `400 30px ${f.display}`;
      for (const l of wrapLines(ctx, p.description, 620)) {
        ctx.fillText(l, 90, y);
        y += 44;
      }
      y += 40;
      ctx.font = `500 20px ${f.mono}`;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      ctx.fillText("BUILT WITH", 90, y);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      y += 44;
      ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
      for (const t of p.tools) {
        ctx.strokeRect(92, y - 18, 18, 18);
        ctx.fillText("×", 94, y - 2);
        ctx.fillText(t.toUpperCase(), 128, y);

      }
      /* stamp */
      ctx.save();

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(196,58,32,0.85)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.strokeRect(-120, -42, 240, 84);
      ctx.font = `800 46px ${f.display}`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("SHIPPED", 0, 16);
      ctx.restore();
      return toTexture(c);
    })();

    return { spine, cover, left, right, color: bg };
  });

  return { books, paperEdge };
}

/* Pegboard tile: cream board with dark rounded slots */
export function pegboardTexture() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(512, 512);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e9e1d0";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
  speckle(ctx, 512, 512, 900, ["#cfc4ae", "#f6efe2"], 1);
  const slot = (x: number, y: number) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2118";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - 9, y - 34, 18, 68, 9);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - 9, y - 33, 18, 68, 9);
    ctx.stroke();
  };
  for (let row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
      slot(64 + col * 128 + (row % 2) * 64 - (row % 2 && col === 3 ? 512 : 0), 64 + row * 128);
    }
  }
  const t = toTexture(c);
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  return t;
}

"use client";

import { useTexture } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { FitModel, MODEL_URLS } from "./FitModel";
import { buildBookTextures, pegboardTexture, type BookProject, type BookTextures } from "./textures";

/* World units: 1 ≈ 8 cm. The desk top is y = 0. */
export const DESK = { halfW: 15, front: 4.8, back: -4.8 };
const WALL_Z = -4.9;

function useOak() {
  const maps = useTexture({
    map: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/diffuse.jpg",
    roughnessMap: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/rough.jpg",
    normalMap: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/nor_gl.jpg",
  });
  return useMemo(() => {
    const make = (repeatX: number, repeatY: number, rotate = false) => {
      const out: Record<string, THREE.Texture> = {};
      for (const [k, t] of Object.entries(maps)) {
        const c = t.clone();
        c.wrapS = c.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
        c.repeat.set(repeatX, repeatY);
        if (rotate) c.rotation = Math.PI / 2;
        if (k === "map") c.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        c.anisotropy = 8;
        c.needsUpdate = true;
        out[k] = c;
      }
      return out as typeof maps;
    };
    return { top: make(2.4, 0.8), front: make(2.4, 0.4) };
  }, [maps]);
}

function DeskBody() {
  const oak = useOak();
  const depth = DESK.front - DESK.back;
  const drawers: [number, number, number][] = [
    /* x, y-center, height */
    [-7.45, -2.1, 2.9],
    [7.45, -2.1, 2.9],
    [-7.45, -6.0, 4.6],
    [7.45, -6.0, 4.6],
  ];
  return (
    <group>
      {/* top slab */}
      <mesh position={[0, -0.25, 0]} receiveShadow castShadow>
        <boxGeometry args={[DESK.halfW * 2, 0.5, depth]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial {...oak.top} color="#d39a63" roughness={0.75} normalScale={new THREE.Vector2(0.4, 0.4)} />
      </mesh>
      {/* carcass */}
      <mesh position={[0, -5.25, -0.1]} receiveShadow>
        <boxGeometry args={[DESK.halfW * 2 - 0.2, 9.5, depth - 0.4]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial {...oak.front} color="#5a3820" roughness={0.8} />
      </mesh>
      {/* push-to-open drawer fronts */}
      {drawers.map(([x, y, h], i) => (
        <mesh key={i} position={[x, y, DESK.front - 0.15]} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[14.8, h, 0.3]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial {...oak.front} color="#8a5a34" roughness={0.7} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      {/* floor, far below */}
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -10, 8]} receiveShadow>
        <planeGeometry args={[120, 60]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#3a2a1e" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function Pegboard() {

    const t = pegboardTexture();

function Decor() {

export function Room() {

      <Suspense fallback={null}>

      <Pegboard />

    </>

}

/* ── Project bookshelf ── */

export const SHELF = { x: 3.9, z: -3.7 };
const BOOK_W = 2.0;
const COVER = 0.05;
const THICK = [0.56, 0.48, 0.62, 0.5, 0.58];
const HEIGHT = [3.1, 2.9, 3.3, 3.0, 3.2];
const OPEN_SECONDS = 1.7;

const ease = (t: number) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2);
const phase = (p: number, a: number, b: number) => ease(THREE.MathUtils.clamp((p - a) / (b - a), 0, 1));

type ShelfProps = {
  projects: readonly BookProject[];
  open: number | null;
  reduced: boolean;
  onOpen: (index: number | null) => void;
  onHover: (index: number | null) => void;
};

function Book({ tex, edge, index, h, t }: { tex: BookTextures["books"][number]; edge: THREE.Texture; index: number; h: number; t: number }) {
  const cloth = <meshStandardMaterial color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />;
  const paper = <meshStandardMaterial map={edge} roughness={0.95} />;
  return (
    <>
      {/* back cover */}
      <mesh position={[BOOK_W / 2, 0, -t / 2 + COVER / 2]} castShadow receiveShadow>

      </mesh>
      {/* text block; +z face is the right-hand page */}
      <mesh position={[(BOOK_W - 0.1) / 2 + 0.04, 0, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>

        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-0" map={edge} roughness={0.95} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-1" map={edge} roughness={0.95} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-2" map={edge} roughness={0.95} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-3" map={edge} roughness={0.95} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-4" map={tex.right} roughness={0.9} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-5" map={edge} roughness={0.95} />
      </mesh>
      {/* spine */}
      <mesh position={[-0.03, 0, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
        <boxGeometry args={[0.06, h, t]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-0" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-1" map={tex.spine} roughness={0.8} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-2" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-3" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-4" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
        <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-5" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
      </mesh>
      {/* front cover, hinged on the spine */}
      <group name={`cover-${index}`} position={[0, 0, t / 2]}>
        <mesh position={[BOOK_W / 2, 0, -COVER / 2]} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[BOOK_W, h, COVER]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-0" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-1" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-2" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-3" color={tex.color} roughness={0.85} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-4" map={tex.cover} roughness={0.85} />
          <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-5" map={tex.left} roughness={0.9} />
        </mesh>
      </group>
      {paper && null}
    </>
  );
}

export function ProjectShelf({ projects, open, reduced, onOpen, onHover }: ShelfProps) {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera) as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  const size = useThree((s) => s.size);
  const [tex, setTex] = useState<BookTextures | null>(null);
  const groups = useRef<(THREE.Group | null)[]>([]);
  const dim = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const [anim] = useState(() => ({
    p: projects.map(() => 0),
    hover: projects.map(() => 0),
    hovered: -1,
    active: null as number | null,
  }));

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    let built: BookTextures | null = null;
    buildBookTextures(projects).then((t) => {
      built = t;
      if (alive) setTex(t);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      if (built) {
        built.paperEdge.dispose();
        built.books.forEach((b) => [b.spine, b.cover, b.left, b.right].forEach((x) => x.dispose()));
      }
    };
  }, [projects]);

  useEffect(() => {
    anim.active = open;
  }, [anim, open]);

  /* resting slots along the shelf */
  const slots = useMemo(() => {
    let x = -2.25;
    return THICK.map((t, i) => {
      const cx = x + t / 2;
      x += t + 0.04;
      return new THREE.Vector3(SHELF.x + cx, 0.2 + HEIGHT[i] / 2, SHELF.z + 1.0);
    });
  }, []);

  const shelfQ = useMemo(() => new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI / 2), []);
  const tmp = useMemo(
    () => ({ pos: new THREE.Vector3(), pulled: new THREE.Vector3(), present: new THREE.Vector3(), fwd: new THREE.Vector3(), right: new THREE.Vector3(), q: new THREE.Quaternion() }),
    [],
  );

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    const aspect = size.width / size.height;
    const tanHalf = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2));
    const widthFrac = aspect < 1 ? 0.92 : 0.5;
    const openW = BOOK_W * 2.1;
    const dist = Math.max(openW / (widthFrac * 2 * tanHalf * aspect), 3.4 / (0.7 * 2 * tanHalf));
    camera.getWorldDirection(tmp.fwd);
    tmp.right.set(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);

    let dimAmount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < projects.length; i++) {
      /* only one book out at a time: the old one goes home before the next leaves */
      const others = anim.p.some((v, k) => k !== i && v > 0.001);
      const goal = anim.active === i && !(others && anim.p[i] === 0) ? 1 : 0;
      const step = reduced ? 1 : dt / OPEN_SECONDS;
      anim.p[i] = goal > anim.p[i] ? Math.min(goal, anim.p[i] + step) : Math.max(goal, anim.p[i] - step * 1.3);
      anim.hover[i] = THREE.MathUtils.damp(anim.hover[i], anim.hovered === i && anim.p[i] === 0 ? 1 : 0, 12, dt);

      const p = anim.p[i];
      const s1 = phase(p, 0, 0.22);
      const s2 = phase(p, 0.22, 0.7);
      const s3 = phase(p, 0.7, 1);
      dimAmount = Math.max(dimAmount, s2);

      const g = groups.current[i];
      if (!g) continue;
      tmp.pulled.copy(slots[i]).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.25, 1.9));
      tmp.pos.copy(slots[i]).lerp(tmp.pulled, s1);
      tmp.pos.z += anim.hover[i] * 0.35;
      tmp.present
        .copy(camera.position)
        .addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, dist)
        .addScaledVector(tmp.right, -(BOOK_W / 2) * (1 - s3));
      tmp.pos.lerp(tmp.present, s2);
      g.position.copy(tmp.pos);
      tmp.q.copy(shelfQ).slerp(camera.quaternion, s2);
      g.quaternion.copy(tmp.q);
      const cover = g.getObjectByName(`cover-${i}`);
      if (cover) cover.rotation.y = -Math.PI * 0.985 * s3;
    }

    if (dim.current) {
      const mat = dim.current.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial;
      mat.opacity = dimAmount * 0.55;
      const live = dimAmount > 0.01;
      dim.current.visible = live;
      dim.current.position.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, live ? dist + 1.2 : -50);
      dim.current.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
    }
  });

  return (
    <group>
      {/* the shelf itself */}
      <group position={[SHELF.x, 0, SHELF.z]}>
        <mesh position={[0, 0.1, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[4.9, 0.2, 2.2]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#6b4428" roughness={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        {[-2.45, 2.45].map((x) => (
          <mesh key={x} position={[x, 1.9, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
            <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 3.8, 2.2]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#6b4428" roughness={0.6} />
          </mesh>
        ))}
      </group>

      {tex &&
        tex.books.map((b, i) => (
          <group
            key={i}
            ref={(g) => {
              groups.current[i] = g;
            }}
            position={slots[i].toArray()}
            quaternion={shelfQ}
            onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            onPointerOver={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              anim.hovered = i;
              onHover(i);
            }}
            onPointerOut={() => {
              anim.hovered = -1;
              onHover(null);
            }}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onOpen(anim.active === i ? null : i);
            }}
          >
            <Book tex={b} edge={tex.paperEdge} index={i} h={HEIGHT[i]} t={THICK[i]} />
          </group>
        ))}

      {/* backdrop that dims the desk while a book is open; click it to close */}
      <mesh
        ref={dim}
        visible={false}
        renderOrder={10}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onOpen(null);
        }}
        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <planeGeometry args={[400, 400]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#120a04" transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

p='src/components/hero/desk/world.ts'

new='''  /*
   * Builds the camera presets for this viewport. Layout always comes from the
   * top view, so objects keep their composition whichever view is active.
   */
  frame(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, width: number, height: number) {
    const aspect = width / height;
    const portrait = aspect < 1;
    const vfov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov);
    const tanHalf = Math.tan(vfov / 2);

    /* top: tight, almost straight-down product shot; portrait runs the desk lengthways */
    const visibleW = portrait ? 7.2 : 11.5;
    const topDist = visibleW / aspect / 2 / tanHalf;
    const el = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(84);
    const top: View = portrait
      ? { pos: new THREE.Vector3(-Math.cos(el) * topDist * 0, Math.sin(el) * topDist, Math.cos(el) * topDist), target: new THREE.Vector3(), up: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0) }
      : { pos: new THREE.Vector3(0, Math.sin(el) * topDist, Math.cos(el) * topDist), target: new THREE.Vector3(), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) };
    if (portrait) top.pos.set(-Math.cos(el) * topDist, Math.sin(el) * topDist, 0);

    this.views = {
      top,
      front: {
        pos: new THREE.Vector3(0, portrait ? 7 : 5.6, portrait ? 44 : 23),
        target: new THREE.Vector3(0, portrait ? 3.4 : 2.6, -1.5),
        up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
      },
      angle: {
        pos: portrait ? new THREE.Vector3(14, 20, 30) : new THREE.Vector3(15, 12, 16),
        target: new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0.4, -0.8),
        up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
      },
    };

    /* scratch camera posed at the top view, for screen-to-desk mapping */
    const scratch = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(camera.fov, aspect, camera.near, camera.far);
    scratch.position.copy(top.pos);
    scratch.up.copy(top.up);
    scratch.lookAt(top.target);
    scratch.updateMatrixWorld();
    scratch.updateProjectionMatrix();
    const plane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);
    const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
    this.screenToDesk = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
      ray.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(nx, ny), scratch);
      const p = ray.ray.intersectPlane(plane, new THREE.Vector3()) ?? new THREE.Vector3();
      return [p.x, p.z];
    };

    const first = !this.laidOut;
    const portraitChanged = this.portrait !== portrait;
    this.portrait = portrait;
    this.laidOut = true;

    for (const b of this.bodies) {
      if (first || portraitChanged) {
        const [x, z] = this.home(b);
        b.pos.x = x;
        b.pos.z = z;
        b.target.set(x, z);
      } else {
        b.target.set(...this.clampToDesk(b, b.target.x, b.target.y));
      }
    }

    if (first) this.snapCamera(camera);
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  setView(view: ViewName) {
    this.view = view;
  }

  private snapCamera(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
    const v = this.views?.[this.view];
    if (!v) return;
    this.cam.pos.copy(v.pos);
    this.cam.target.copy(v.target);
    this.cam.up.copy(v.up);
    this.applyCamera(camera);
  }

  private applyCamera(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
    camera.position.copy(this.cam.pos);
    camera.up.copy(this.cam.up).normalize();
    camera.lookAt(this.cam.target);
    camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  }

  stepCamera(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, delta: number) {
    const v = this.views?.[this.view];
    if (!v) return;
    if (this.reduced) {
      this.snapCamera(camera);
      return;
    }
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    const k = 1 - Math.exp(-3.2 * dt);
    this.cam.pos.lerp(v.pos, k);
    this.cam.target.lerp(v.target, k);
    this.cam.up.lerp(v.up, k).normalize();
    this.applyCamera(camera);
  }

  private home(b: Body): [number, number] {
    const { fx, fz } = this.portrait && b.item.m ? b.item.m : b.item;
    return this.screenToDesk(fx * 0.93, -fz * 0.84);
  }

  private clampToDesk(b: Body, x: number, z: number): [number, number] {
    const [ex, ez] = extents(b);
    /* keep everything on the desk top */
    const mx = DESK.halfW - ex * 0.6;
    return [clamp(x, -mx, mx), clamp(z, DESK.back + ez * 0.55, DESK.front - ez * 0.45)];
  }

This round is in: a full room you can view from three camera angles, more realistic objects, and the bookshelf for projects. Type check and lint pass. The hand, drawer animation and the other sections aren't built yet.

**Checked with screenshots:**
- All three views on desktop.
- Top and Front on phone.
- A book click: it opened to the case file and the project bar appeared.

The test browser renders very slowly, so I took most of the stills with animations turned off. I haven't seen the motion at full speed; please check it in your browser.

**The room**
- The desk now has real thickness, an oak top using a free (CC0) wood texture, and four drawer fronts.
- A pegboard wall stands behind it, and window-frame shadows fall across the wall and the desk.
- New free (CC0) 3D models from Poly Haven:
  - a Leica-style camera, replacing my hand-built one (I removed its strap);
  - an orange desk lamp;
  - a potted plant.

**Camera angles**
- A Top / Front / Angle switch sits at the bottom centre. The camera glides between views.
- **Top** is the Oryzo shot you had before.
- **Front** is eye level, like your photo: wall, lamp, plant, books, and the desk edge with drawers.
- **Angle** is a three-quarter view looking down across the desk.
- On phones the top view turns the desk lengthways so it fills the tall screen.
- Objects can still be dragged in every view, and they can no longer be pushed off the desk.

**Projects bookshelf**
- A wooden shelf sits at the back right of the desk with your 5 projects as cloth hardcovers. Each spine shows the project title and number.
- Hovering a book makes it slide out slightly and shows its title.
- Clicking one: it pulls off the shelf, flies toward the camera, and opens.
  - The left page has the project screenshot taped in.
  - The right page has the description, a "built with" checklist and a red SHIPPED stamp.
- The rest of the desk darkens while a book is open.
- A bar underneath shows "Project 04 / 05" with ← → buttons, a GitHub link and Close.
- Closing: Esc, the Close button, or clicking the dark area. The book flies back to its slot. Arrow keys also move between projects.

**Not done yet**
1. **The hand.** Nothing is built yet. To match the other objects it needs a realistic posable 3D hand model, then a scripted reach-grab-pull sequence.
2. **Drawer opening.** The drawer fronts are in place. Next: the hand opens one and takes out the résumé — I downloaded a free clipboard model for this.
3. **Other sections:**
   - About: the portrait polaroid flips over. I haven't added placeholder photos yet; that's planned for this step.
   - Contact: the Nothing Phone flips face-up.
   - Experience: a notebook — I downloaded a free binder model for it.
   - Tech stack: keycaps.

**Things to know**
- The site is now heavier: about 12 MB of models and 3.4 MB of textures. The clipboard and binder are already in that total but not used yet.
- The red "1 Issue" badge in my screenshots is a warning from the existing fade-in animations in the Contact section, not from this work. It only appeared because I turned animations off for testing.
- The old Features / Product / Contact scroll sections are still below the desk.
- The new code is in [room.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/room.tsx) (desk, wall, shelf, books), [world.ts](src/components/hero/desk/world.ts) (camera views) and [FitModel.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/FitModel.tsx) (loads the downloaded models).

```typescript
"use client";

import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

/*
 * Desk lamp placement. In the glTF the shade points along local -z and the
 * bulb sits ~6.5 units up once the model is scaled to 7.5 units tall.
 */
const LAMP_POS = new THREE.Vector3(-9.6, 0, -2.6);
const LAMP_AIM = new THREE.Vector3(-1.4, 0, 0.6);
const BULB_LOCAL = new THREE.Vector3(0.13, 6.5, -1.6);

export const LAMP = (() => {
  const dx = LAMP_AIM.x - LAMP_POS.x;
  const dz = LAMP_AIM.z - LAMP_POS.z;
  const yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
  const bulb = BULB_LOCAL.clone().applyAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), yaw).add(LAMP_POS);
  return { pos: LAMP_POS, yaw, bulb, aim: LAMP_AIM };
})();

const DAY = {
  hemiSky: new THREE.Color("#ffe6c8"),
  hemiGround: new THREE.Color("#6a4226"),
  hemi: 1.05,
  sunColor: new THREE.Color("#ffe4c4"),
  sun: 2.8,
  env: 1,
};

const NIGHT = {
  hemiSky: new THREE.Color("#3c4a68"),
  hemiGround: new THREE.Color("#1a120c"),
  hemi: 0.12,
  sunColor: new THREE.Color("#8ea4d6"),
  sun: 0.22,
  env: 0.12,
};

/* a few quick stutters when the lamp switches on, like an old bulb */
const FLICKER = [1, 0.15, 0.9, 0.3, 1, 0.6, 1];

/* Mutable light rig, stepped every frame. */
class LightRig {
  hemi: THREE.HemisphereLight | null = null;
  sun: THREE.DirectionalLight | null = null;
  spot: THREE.SpotLight | null = null;
  glow: THREE.PointLight | null = null;
  bulbMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;
  private mix = 0;
  private lamp = 0;
  private onAt = -1;
  private clock = 0;

  findBulb(scene: THREE.Scene) {
    if (this.bulbMat) return;
    scene.getObjectByName("desk-lamp")?.traverse((o) => {
      const m = (o as THREE.Mesh).material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | undefined;
      if (m && m.name?.endsWith("_light")) {
        m.emissive = new THREE.Color("#ffb46b");
        this.bulbMat = m;
      }
    });
  }

  step(scene: THREE.Scene, night: boolean, reduced: boolean, delta: number) {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    this.clock += dt;
    const goal = night ? 1 : 0;
    this.mix = reduced ? goal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.mix, goal, 2.4, dt);

    if (night && this.onAt < 0) this.onAt = this.clock + (reduced ? 0 : 0.35);
    if (!night) this.onAt = -1;
    let lampGoal = 0;
    if (night && this.clock >= this.onAt) {
      const step = Math.floor((this.clock - this.onAt) / 0.07);
      lampGoal = reduced ? 1 : (FLICKER[step] ?? 1);
    }
    this.lamp = reduced || lampGoal > this.lamp ? lampGoal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.lamp, lampGoal, 6, dt);

    const m = this.mix;
    if (this.hemi) {
      this.hemi.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.hemi, NIGHT.hemi, m);
      this.hemi.color.lerpColors(DAY.hemiSky, NIGHT.hemiSky, m);
      this.hemi.groundColor.lerpColors(DAY.hemiGround, NIGHT.hemiGround, m);
    }
    if (this.sun) {
      this.sun.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.sun, NIGHT.sun, m);
      this.sun.color.lerpColors(DAY.sunColor, NIGHT.sunColor, m);
    }
    scene.environmentIntensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.env, NIGHT.env, m);
    if (this.spot) this.spot.intensity = 420 * this.lamp;
    if (this.glow) this.glow.intensity = 9 * this.lamp;
    if (this.bulbMat) this.bulbMat.emissiveIntensity = 6 * this.lamp;
  }
}

export function Lighting({ night, reduced }: { night: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const scene = useThree((s) => s.scene);
  const [rig] = useState(() => new LightRig());
  const target = useRef<THREE.Object3D>(null);
  const shadowSize = useMemo(() => [1024, 1024] as [number, number], []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rig.spot && target.current) rig.spot.target = target.current;
  }, [rig]);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    rig.findBulb(scene);
    rig.step(scene, night, reduced, delta);
  });

  return (
    <>
      <hemisphereLight ref={(l) => void (rig.hemi = l)} args={[DAY.hemiSky, DAY.hemiGround, DAY.hemi]} />
      <directionalLight
        ref={(l) => void (rig.sun = l)}
        castShadow
        position={[-9, 20, 12]}
        intensity={DAY.sun}
        color={DAY.sunColor}
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-camera-left={-26}
        shadow-camera-right={26}
        shadow-camera-top={26}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-26}
        shadow-camera-near={1}
        shadow-camera-far={70}
        shadow-bias={-0.0004}
        shadow-normalBias={0.02}
        shadow-radius={10}
      />

      {/* desk lamp: warm 2700K cone onto the objects, plus a soft glow around the shade */}
      <object3D ref={target} position={LAMP.aim.toArray()} />
      <spotLight
        ref={(l) => {
          rig.spot = l;
          if (l && target.current) l.target = target.current;
        }}
        position={LAMP.bulb.toArray()}
        color="#ffb46b"
        intensity={0}
        angle={0.62}
        penumbra={0.85}
        decay={2}
        distance={40}
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={shadowSize}
        shadow-bias={-0.0006}
        shadow-normalBias={0.03}
        shadow-radius={6}
      />
      <pointLight ref={(l) => void (rig.glow = l)} position={LAMP.bulb.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)).toArray()} color="#ffae5e" intensity={0} distance={9} decay={2} />
    </>
  );
}

```

function subscribeDark(onChange: () => void) {

/* Night follows the system theme until the visitor flips the lamp themselves. */
function useNight() {

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-07 15:10:54Z)**_

Dark mode now turns the desk lamp on and gives the scene a warm, late-night study look; the iPad switches to a night lock screen. I checked it in all three camera views, and I checked day mode in the top view with the setting forced to light. Day still looks the same. Type check and lint pass.

**How it switches**
- The scene follows your system's dark-mode setting. Your Windows is in dark mode, so you'll see the night version by default.
- A moon/sun button next to Top / Front / Angle overrides it.
- Clicking the lamp also toggles night and day. Hovering it shows a "Desk lamp — click to switch it on" caption.

**At night**
- **Light:** the daylight fades over about a second to faint blue moonlight, and the window-frame shadows stay faintly visible.
- **The lamp:** it switches on with a quick old-bulb flicker. The bulb glows and a warm amber cone of light falls across the cutting mat and the objects on it.
  - I moved the lamp closer to the desk and turned it so its head faces the objects.
  - The light fades gently across the mat instead of making a hot spot near the lamp.
  - Objects cast real shadows from the lamp; in the angle view the camera and ruler throw long shadows across the desk.
- **iPad:** the lock screen now shows 11:47 over a dark blue wallpaper with stars and "Sleep focus on". By day it's back to 9:41.
- **Nothing Phone:** its glyph lights glow.
- **Page:** the background goes near-black, the edges darken more, and the frosted cards turn a warmer, darker brown.

Reduced-motion users get the switch instantly, with no fade or flicker.

The lamp's light can be aimed, but the lamp model can't be re-posed: it's a single solid piece, so I could only turn and move the whole lamp. The lamp position and aim point are at the top of [lighting.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/lighting.tsx).

method='''  /*
   * Flashlight held just off the camera's shoulder. It clicks on with a short
   * stutter once the book is open, then tracks the cursor across the pages.
   */
  private stepTorch(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, fwd: THREE.Vector3, dist: number, dt: number, reduced: boolean, on: boolean, pointer: THREE.Vector2) {
    const torch = this.torch;
    if (!torch) return;

    if (on && this.torchOnAt < 0) this.torchOnAt = this.clock;
    if (!on) this.torchOnAt = -1;
    let goal = 0;
    if (on) {
      const step = Math.floor((this.clock - this.torchOnAt) / 0.06);
      goal = reduced ? 1 : (TORCH_FLICKER[step] ?? 1);
    }
    this.torchLevel = reduced || goal > this.torchLevel ? goal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.torchLevel, goal, 8, dt);
    torch.intensity = 3.2 * dist * this.torchLevel;
    torch.visible = this.torchLevel > 0.001;

    /* hand position: a little right of and below the eye */
    const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
    const right = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
    torch.position.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(right, 1.6).addScaledVector(up, -1.1);

    /* aim where the cursor meets the page plane */
    const center = camera.position.clone().addScaledVector(fwd, dist);
    this.plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(fwd.clone().negate(), center);
    this.ray.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const hit = this.ray.ray.intersectPlane(this.plane, new THREE.Vector3()) ?? center;
    if (!this.aimReady || reduced || this.torchLevel === 0) {
      /* first frame: start from the middle of the spread so the beam sweeps in */
      this.aim.copy(this.aimReady && !reduced ? hit : center);
      this.aimReady = true;
    }
    this.aim.x = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.x, hit.x, 9, dt);
    this.aim.y = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.y, hit.y, 9, dt);
    this.aim.z = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.z, hit.z, 9, dt);
    torch.target.position.copy(this.aim);
    torch.target.updateMatrixWorld();
  }

'''

- **Turning on:** once the book has finished opening, the beam clicks on with a short stutter. When you close the book it fades out.

- **Reduced motion:** the beam comes on without the stutter or the sweep.

export class SceneLink {
  bookCenter = new THREE.Vector3();
  bookNormal = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
  bookOpen = 0;
  flashHeld = false;

  setBook(center: THREE.Vector3, normal: THREE.Vector3, open: number) {
    this.bookCenter.copy(center);
    this.bookNormal.copy(normal);
    this.bookOpen = open;
  }

  setFlashHeld(held: boolean) {
    this.flashHeld = held;
  }
}

/* where the torch rests on the desk */
export const FLASH_HOME = new THREE.Vector3(-2.3, 0, 2.5);
const FLASH_YAW = 2.3;
const R = 0.2;
const PICKUP_SECONDS = 0.9;
const CLICK = [0, 1, 0.15, 1, 0.4, 1];

/* A machined aluminium torch; the head points along local +z. */
function TorchModel({ lensRef }: { lensRef: (m: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null) => void }) {
  const knurl = useMemo(() => Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => -0.55 + i * 0.09), []);
  const body = <meshStandardMaterial color="#2a2c2f" metalness={0.85} roughness={0.38} />;
  return (
    <group>
      {/* barrel */}
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, -0.1]}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[R * 0.92, R * 0.92, 1.5, 40]} />
        {body}
      </mesh>
      {/* grip rings */}
      {knurl.map((z) => (
        <mesh key={z} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, z]}>
          <torusGeometry args={[R * 0.93, 0.012, 8, 40]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#1c1d1f" metalness={0.7} roughness={0.5} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      {/* tail cap + rubber switch */}
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, -0.9]}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[R, R, 0.16, 40]} />
        {body}
      </mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, -0.99]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[R * 0.6, 24, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#121212" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
      {/* flared head */}
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, 0.82]}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[R * 1.45, R * 0.95, 0.38, 40]} />
        {body}
      </mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0, 1.03]}>
        <torusGeometry args={[R * 1.4, 0.035, 12, 48]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#b9bbbe" metalness={1} roughness={0.22} />
      </mesh>
      {/* reflector + lens: glows when on */}
      <mesh position={[0, 0, 1.02]}>
        <circleGeometry args={[R * 1.36, 40]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial ref={lensRef} color="#d9dde2" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.08} emissive="#fff1d0" emissiveIntensity={0} />
      </mesh>
      {/* pocket clip */}
      <mesh position={[0, R * 0.98, -0.45]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[0.06, 0.03, 0.62]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#9da0a4" metalness={1} roughness={0.3} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

class FlashRig {
  group: THREE.Group | null = null;
  lens: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;
  spot: THREE.SpotLight | null = null;
  private pick = 0;
  private light = 0;
  private onAt = -1;
  private clock = 0;
  private aim = new THREE.Vector3();
  private homeQ = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, FLASH_YAW, 0));
  private ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
  private m = new THREE.Matrix4();
  private tmp = {
    pos: new THREE.Vector3(),
    held: new THREE.Vector3(),
    fwd: new THREE.Vector3(),
    right: new THREE.Vector3(),
    up: new THREE.Vector3(),
    q: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    look: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    hit: new THREE.Vector3(),
    lensPos: new THREE.Vector3(),
  };

  attachGroup(g: THREE.Group | null) {
    this.group = g;
  }

  attachLens(m: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null) {
    this.lens = m;
  }

  attachSpot(l: THREE.SpotLight | null) {
    this.spot = l;
  }

  /* nearest of: open book page, desk top, pegboard wall */
  private findAim(camera: THREE.Camera, pointer: THREE.Vector2, link: SceneLink) {
    this.ray.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
    const r = this.ray.ray;
    let best = Infinity;
    const out = this.tmp.hit;
    const consider = (plane: THREE.Plane, ok: (p: THREE.Vector3) => boolean) => {
      const p = r.intersectPlane(plane, new THREE.Vector3());
      if (!p || !ok(p)) return;
      const d = p.distanceTo(r.origin);
      if (d < best) {
        best = d;
        out.copy(p);
      }
    };
    if (link.bookOpen > 0.5) {
      consider(new THREE.Plane().setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(link.bookNormal, link.bookCenter), () => true);
    }
    consider(new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0), (p) => Math.abs(p.x) < DESK.halfW && p.z > DESK.back && p.z < DESK.front + 0.5);
    consider(new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), 4.85), (p) => p.y > 0);
    if (best === Infinity) out.copy(r.origin).addScaledVector(r.direction, 20);
    return out;
  }

  step(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, pointer: THREE.Vector2, link: SceneLink, held: boolean, reduced: boolean, delta: number) {
    const g = this.group;
    if (!g) return;
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    this.clock += dt;
    const { tmp } = this;

    /* pick up, then click on; switch off, then put down */
    const lit = held && this.pick > 0.98;
    if (lit && this.onAt < 0) this.onAt = this.clock;
    if (!lit) this.onAt = -1;
    const lightGoal = lit ? (reduced ? 1 : (CLICK[Math.floor((this.clock - this.onAt) / 0.06)] ?? 1)) : 0;
    this.light = reduced || lightGoal > this.light ? lightGoal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.light, lightGoal, 10, dt);
    const canMove = held || this.light < 0.02;
    const pickGoal = held ? 1 : 0;
    if (canMove) {
      const stepAmt = reduced ? 1 : dt / PICKUP_SECONDS;
      this.pick = pickGoal > this.pick ? Math.min(1, this.pick + stepAmt) : Math.max(0, this.pick - stepAmt);
    }
    link.setFlashHeld(this.pick > 0.5);

    const s = this.pick < 0.5 ? 4 * this.pick ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * this.pick + 2) ** 3 / 2;

    camera.getWorldDirection(tmp.fwd);
    tmp.right.set(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
    tmp.up.set(0, 1, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);

    /* held like a first-person item: low and to the right of the view */
    const narrow = camera.aspect < 1;
    tmp.held
      .copy(camera.position)
      .addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, 4.2)
      .addScaledVector(tmp.right, narrow ? 0.9 : 1.75)
      .addScaledVector(tmp.up, narrow ? -1.5 : -0.95);

    /* aim follows the cursor, with a little lag like a real wrist */
    const target = this.findAim(camera, pointer, link);
    if (this.pick < 0.01) this.aim.copy(target);
    const k = reduced ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-10 * dt);
    this.aim.lerp(target, k);

    tmp.pos.copy(FLASH_HOME).setY(R).lerp(tmp.held, s);
    tmp.pos.y += Math.sin(Math.PI * s) * 1.4;
    this.m.lookAt(this.aim, tmp.held, tmp.up);
    tmp.look.setFromRotationMatrix(this.m);
    /* Matrix4.lookAt points -z at the target; flip so the head (+z) leads */
    tmp.look.multiply(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI));
    tmp.q.copy(this.homeQ).slerp(tmp.look, s);
    g.position.copy(tmp.pos);
    g.quaternion.copy(tmp.q);

    if (this.lens) this.lens.emissiveIntensity = 3 * this.light;
    if (this.spot) {
      tmp.lensPos.set(0, 0, 1.1).applyQuaternion(g.quaternion).add(g.position);
      this.spot.position.copy(tmp.lensPos);
      this.spot.target.position.copy(this.aim);
      this.spot.target.updateMatrixWorld();
      this.spot.intensity = 2.2 * Math.max(4, this.aim.distanceTo(tmp.lensPos)) * this.light;
    }
  }
}

type Props = {
  link: SceneLink;
  held: boolean;
  reduced: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onHover: (on: boolean) => void;
};

export function Flashlight({ link, held, reduced, onToggle, onHover }: Props) {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera) as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  const [rig] = useState(() => new FlashRig());

  useFrame((state, delta) => rig.step(camera, state.pointer, link, held, reduced, delta));

  return (
    <>
      <group
        ref={(g) => rig.attachGroup(g)}
        position={[FLASH_HOME.x, R, FLASH_HOME.z]}
        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onToggle();
        }}
        onPointerOver={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onHover(true);
        }}
        onPointerOut={() => onHover(false)}
      >
        <group
          ref={(g) =>
            g?.traverse((o) => {
              o.castShadow = true;
              o.receiveShadow = true;
            })
          }
        >
          <TorchModel lensRef={(m) => rig.attachLens(m)} />
        </group>
      </group>
      <spotLight ref={(l) => rig.attachSpot(l)} color="#fff3dc" intensity={0} angle={0.26} penumbra={0.65} decay={1} distance={90} castShadow shadow-mapSize={[1024, 1024]} shadow-bias={-0.0005} />
    </>
  );
}

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = gl.domElement;
    let last = 0;
    const spread = (e: TouchEvent) => Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY);
    const onStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (e.touches.length === 2) last = spread(e);
    };
    const onMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (e.touches.length !== 2 || world.grabbing) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const d = spread(e);
      if (last) world.zoomBy((last - d) * 2.2);
      last = d;
    };
    el.addEventListener("touchstart", onStart, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("touchmove", onMove, { passive: false });
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener("touchstart", onStart);
      el.removeEventListener("touchmove", onMove);
    };
  }, [gl, world]);'''),

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-07 15:49:16Z)**_

All three are in: the flashlight, wheel zoom, and a more visible bookshelf. Type check and lint pass. I checked them in screenshots with animations off, because the test browser renders too slowly to judge motion. The pick-up sweep and the beam following a moving cursor still need a look in your browser.

**Flashlight**
- A metal flashlight now lies on the desk, between the business card and the cutting mat.
- At night you pick it up by clicking it, pressing F, or using a new flashlight button next to the sun/moon toggle. Pick-up takes about 0.9s:
  1. It lifts off the desk in an arc and settles at the bottom-right of the screen, like an item held in first person.
  2. It clicks on with a short stutter.
- The beam follows the cursor with a slight lag. It lights whatever you point at: the desk, the pegboard wall, or the pages of an open book. Objects cast shadows from it.
- While you hold it, it replaces the automatic reading light on open books.
- To put it down, click it again or press F: it switches off, then goes back to its spot.
- Switching to day puts it down automatically. In daylight, clicking it only shows "Best after dark".
- A bug I hit: once fully picked up, the flashlight dropped straight back to the desk on the next frame with its light still on. That's fixed.

**Zoom instead of page scroll**
- Over the desk, the mouse wheel now zooms the camera in and out in all three views, roughly 0.4× to 1.5× of the normal framing.
- The page stays put (I confirmed it stays at the top). Switching views resets the zoom.
- On phones, two-finger pinch zooms; swiping on the desk no longer scrolls the page.
- Features, Product and Contact still exist, but you only reach them through the nav tabs. "Scroll to continue" now reads "Scroll to zoom".
- Zoom is paused while a book is open, and the wheel still rotates an object while you're dragging it.

**Bookshelf in the top view**
- The shelf moved further onto the desk. From above, you now see the spines of all five books instead of a cropped strip.
- A "● Projects 05" tag with a pulsing orange dot sits in front of the shelf in every view. Clicking it opens the first book. It hides while a book is open.

**Worth knowing**
- Phone users can no longer scroll down from the desk at all. They have to use the menu to reach the other sections.
- The held flashlight covers part of the bottom-right caption card.

The new code is in [flashlight.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/flashlight.tsx); the zoom is in [world.ts](src/components/hero/desk/world.ts) and the wheel/pinch handling in [DeskCanvas.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/DeskCanvas.tsx).
